fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the 1928 presidential campaign (Hoover and Smith) and anti-Klan material, including reproduced Klan documents and discussion of Klan activity. Local civic coverage addresses Jackson Memorial Hospital governance and the Deering Fund, with criticism of political and banking influence. Additional pieces discuss prohibition enforcement and dangers of illicit liquor, local and state politics (including Florida races for governor and justice of the peace), tourism and racing as an economic issue, labor dispute coverage related to the Capitol Theatre, and assorted columns, humor items, and advertisements for Miami-area businesses and entertainment.
